# Bam Studio

> Bam Studio is a small independent app studio making apps for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Android, Wear OS, TV (Apple TV, Google TV, Samsung, LG) and the web. 16 apps are live on the App Store and Google Play. Website: https://bamstudio.dev · Contact: merhaba@bamstudio.dev

Each app has a tour page, a privacy policy and store links. Apps never sell user data. Bam Studio also builds apps for clients (design, development, store listing and release): https://bamstudio.dev/#birlikte

## Apps
- [Wallet Coach: Monthly Budget](https://bamstudio.dev/walletcoach/): Household books kept like a spreadsheet with a tab per month: write the month once, tick things off as they are paid, let the next month copy itself. Scans receipts, works out your own inflation. Platforms: iOS, Android. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6798041415, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aberk.walletcoach.
- [Nika: Wedding Planner](https://bamstudio.dev/nika/): Plan the wedding together: tasks, budget, guests, seating and a gift log. Guests reply to the invitation without installing anything and drop their photos into the album with a QR on the day. In closed testing on Android, the iPhone version is on the way. Platforms: iOS (soon), Android (soon).
- [Tennis & Padel: Score Keeper](https://bamstudio.dev/tennis-padel/): Tap to score and the rules take care of themselves: tiebreaks, golden points, sets. Runs standalone on Apple Watch and Wear OS, so the phone can stay in the locker room. 2.0 adds a social side: follows, a feed, leagues, two phones on one match. Platforms: iOS, Android, watchOS, Wear OS. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6756925523, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aberk.wear.
- [Era: Life & Trip Journal](https://bamstudio.dev/era/): Your own life journal. Write a memory with its date, place and people; draw trips as routes, then read it all page by page like a book. There are envelopes too, sealed until a day you pick. No account needed. Platforms: iOS (soon).
- [BodyBook: Mole Tracker](https://bamstudio.dev/bodybook/): Photograph your moles from the same angle and compare them every 3 to 6 months with the ABCDE checklist. Skincare routine and pill reminders are in there too. Everything stays on your phone. Now on iPhone as well. Platforms: iOS, Android. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6799754171, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aberk.bodybook.
- [Daily Whisper: Affirmations](https://bamstudio.dev/daily-whisper/): Every morning a short story written for you. A scene from the life you want, with your name in it, read by a calm voice while you close your eyes and listen. Redesigned from scratch in 2.0. Platforms: iOS, watchOS. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6757824195. Website: https://dailywhisper.bamstudio.dev/.
- [Nubi: Virtual Pet](https://bamstudio.dev/nubi/): A virtual pet that lives in real time. Hungry while you work, sleepy at night, a little bored when you forget it, and growing up right in front of you. Platforms: iOS, Android. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6816090205, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aberk.nubi.
- [Konfeti: Party TV](https://bamstudio.dev/konfeti/): A party game for your TV. You pick a game with the remote, guests scan the QR on screen and vote from their phones; photos, scores and the night's recap show up on the big screen. It runs in the browser today. Samsung and LG are in review, Google TV and Apple TV are on the way. Platforms: Web, Apple TV (soon), Android TV (soon), Samsung TV (soon), LG TV (soon). Website: https://konfeti.bamstudio.dev/.
- [O mu Bu mu?: This or That](https://bamstudio.dev/o-mu-bu-mu/): Impossible choices and tournaments, Turkish edition. Played out loud with friends, arguments guaranteed. Platforms: iOS, Android, watchOS, Wear OS. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/id6740251305, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.berkalparslan.thisOne.
- [Tasbih Tally: Digital Counter](https://bamstudio.dev/tasbih-tally/): Dhikr counter, prayer times and qibla. On Apple Watch and Wear OS it counts with haptics, so you never lose count. Platforms: iOS, Android, watchOS, Wear OS. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6756802776, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aberk.tasbihTally.
- [Leafbook: Plant Tracker](https://bamstudio.dev/leafbook/): A photo diary for houseplants. Identify from a photo, get a watering schedule that knows the season, shoot from the same angle with the ghost camera. 1.2 adds a community: look at other people's plants and ask what those brown tips mean. Platforms: iOS, Android. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6811846217, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aberk.leafbook.
- [No Spaces: Parking Tycoon](https://bamstudio.dev/bosyeryok/): A parking lot tycoon. You don't steer, you run the place: you set the tariff, hire the crew, and wages come out of the till every second. Now on iPhone too. Platforms: iOS, Android. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6806977094, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aberk.bosyeryok.
- [Kit: QR Scanner & Wallet](https://bamstudio.dev/kit-qr/): Reads every code, keeps loyalty cards and tickets in one wallet and makes QR codes that look good. Checks a link before you open it. No ads, no account. Platforms: iOS, watchOS. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6446224550.
- [Yonca: Çekiliş](https://bamstudio.dev/yonca/): Run your own giveaway or track the ones you entered. Paste the names, draw the winners, share the card; it reminds you on result day too. Platforms: iOS. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6802312123.
- [Matchday: Five a side](https://bamstudio.dev/matchday/): The weekly five-a-side, organised: set up the match, invite, pick the lineup, log the score. Afterwards everyone rates each other anonymously. Platforms: iOS (soon), Android (soon).
- [Pickleball: Score Keeper](https://bamstudio.dev/pickleball/): Server, side-out and rally scoring handled for you. Glance at your wrist instead of arguing about the score. In 2.0 you can follow friends and run a league. Platforms: iOS, watchOS. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760598754.
- [Orbix: Roulette](https://bamstudio.dev/orbix-roulette/): A beautiful decision wheel. Who pays, who goes first, where to eat: spin it and stop arguing. Platforms: watchOS, Wear OS. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6756230899, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aberk.orbixroulette.
- [Volleyball: Score Keeper](https://bamstudio.dev/volleyball/): Live set scoring with a match logbook and heart rate stats pulled from your workout. 2.0 brings leagues, a feed and results you share with the other side. Platforms: iOS, watchOS. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760615315.
- [Rally: Badminton: Score Keeper](https://bamstudio.dev/rally-badminton/): Rally scoring, service court and side changes handled for you, with 21-point games and the two-point rule built in. 2.0 adds follows, leagues and two phones on one match. Platforms: iOS, watchOS. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6802337158.
- [Rally: Table Tennis: Score Keeper](https://bamstudio.dev/rally-table-tennis/): Eleven up, serve swaps every two points, deuce that keeps going. Stop counting out loud. In 2.0 you send the result to your opponent and it lands in their logbook once they confirm. Platforms: iOS, watchOS. Stores: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6802339775.
- [Bumpline: Pregnancy Tracker](https://bamstudio.dev/bumpline/): Forty weeks from a single date. Which week you are in, how big the baby is, how many days are left; with a widget, a journal and a shareable card. Platforms: iOS (soon).
- [Framegrove: Creative Assets](https://framegrove.bamstudio.dev/): Your app's new showcase: App Store Creative Assets, iPhone Duo and store screenshots. 56 curated templates, a layer editor and MCP/skill automation. Free and open source. Platforms: Web.
- [Mihenk: App Estimator](https://mihenk.bamstudio.dev/): Estimates how many times any app was downloaded and what it earns, from App Store and Google Play data. Size up a rival, measure a market. Platforms: Web.
